Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1, Scope — Specifies shape, basic dimensions and technical requirements of screw threads of shutter 
cable release tip and socket to ensure interchangeability of cable releases. 

2, Shape, Basic Dimensions and Tolerances 

2.1 Tip and Socket — The shape and dimensions shall be as shown in Fig, 1 and 2.

3. Construction 
31 Tip 

3.1.1 The extension of the plunger beyond the end of the tip shall not be less than 12 mm. When 
the cable release is relaxed, the plunger shall not extend beyond the end of the tip. There shall be no 
failure of the cable when a resisting force of 20 N (2 kgf, approx) is applied to the guided plunger. 

3.1.2 The tip shall be designed with tapered threads as shown in Fig. 1, 

3.2 Socket — The socket shall be designed with tapered threads as shown in Fig. 2. 

3.3 Profile of Tapered Screw Threads

3.3.1 The bisector of the flank angle shall be perpendicular to the bolt axis and the thread pitch 
shall be measured parallel to the axis of the bolt. 

3.3.2 The maximum deviation of the flank angle shall be ztO'S*". 

3.3.3 The maximum deviation of the thread pitch shall be ± 0"02 mm between any two consecutive 
turns. 



EXPLANATORY NOT^ 

Part 2 of this standard shall cover other requirements of shutter cable release. 

In preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from ISO 6053-1979 
'Photography-shutter cable release tip and socket-dimensions', issued by the Internationa! Organiza- 
tion for Standardization ( ISO ).
